completedModelPhoto.directlyShown: Completed set photo containing two separate vehicles. The left Martian craft is the source identity; its pilot, radial perforated shield, green light elements, black central connector and open platform are visible in one three-quarter view.

archivalInstructionScan.page1Use: Completed composition and assembly steps for the Martian craft.

directlyShown: One turquoise Martian operator in an orange open frame at a control console.
Low open green/turquoise platform with a triangular appearance in the supplied angle.
Pale-gray radial shield with open spokes/holes at the rear.
Green box and translucent green beacon, a black cylindrical connector, and two green cone-like transparent elements around the pilot platform.
Dark underside propeller components; BrickLink inventory lists one black three-blade propeller.

directorClarification.statement: The layout is symmetric on the forward-rear centerline: rear centered radial shield and green beacon box, central black tube, triangular pilot platform with a matched pair of green cone lamps, operator at the front.
directorClarification.correction: The previous v1/v2 description of offset/asymmetric source geometry was a perspective-reading error and is superseded.
